lane: H66-C native-resolution LiDAR scarp channels (scarplet diffusion inversion + Steger/Frangi lines + TIGER cultural mask + catalogue-gap gate)
verdict: NEGATIVE — gate not met; artifact published as a review candidate only
hypothesis: Faults the organisers' experts added are (a) systematically far from the public Quaternary-fault catalogue, because they sit in mapping gaps, and (b) expressed as low-amplitude, diffusion-aged but along-strike-coherent scarplets that a 100 m stack destroys. Inverting the diffused-scarp template on the 2 m-computed LiDAR descriptors recovers scarp height a and morphologic age kappa-t, which together with sub-pixel Steger/Frangi line measures and an official road mask should localise those scarplets better than an amplitude-only 100 m detector.
mechanism: For a step of height a diffusing for morphologic age kappa*t, z=(a/2)[1+erf(x/(2*sqrt(kappa t)))], so max|z'|=a/(2 sqrt(pi kappa t)) and max|z''|=0.12096 a/(kappa t). Eliminating kappa t gives a_hat = 1.5203 S^2/C and kappa*t_hat = 1.5203^2 a_hat^2/(4 pi S^2), with S the 2 m slope excess (ex_max) and C the 6 m-LoG curvature dipole sqrt(lapneg_max*lappos_max). A scarp that survives diffusion keeps an antisymmetric crest-convexity/toe-concavity pair and a coherent along-strike line even once its height is small; Steger's sub-pixel normal test and Frangi's R_B/S vesselness separate that from an isolated slope break.
named_non_fault_mimic: Fluvial terrace riser (the leading mimic: it has the same curvature dipole and a coherent strike). Mandatory additional controls: natural channel banks, landslide headscarps, paleo-shorelines, graded road and canal embankments, mine benches, and 3DEP tile seams.

holdout_dti.label: HOLDOUT-DTI
holdout_dti.evaluator: gems.metric.tversky_terms / dti_from_terms (alpha=0.2, beta=0.8, 300 m triangular kernel), pooled over 14 held-out 20 km blocks, block bootstrap 95% CI (400 resamples)
holdout_dti.instrument: N — USGS SGMC geologic-map fault pixels >300 m from the full catalogue, inside LiDAR-covered held blocks; out-of-sample for the field (the field is trained on catalogue pixels only)
holdout_dti.verdict: NOT MET — the candidate is below every frozen baseline on this instrument

instrument_validity.confound: Spearman(dots, live) = -0.844 on the same set; the partial correlation is not identified
instrument_validity.counter_instrument: S (withheld catalogue segments in held blocks) has Spearman -0.708 with live score: it measures rediscovery of the public catalogue, which the organisers' truth explicitly excludes, so it is structurally anti-correlated with the objective.

leakage_canary.instrument: S (held-block mapping gaps); positives = withheld catalogue segments in held blocks, controls = non-fault cells >600 m from any catalogue pixel in the same blocks

relief_stratification.note: The candidate scores in all three relief classes and its maximum is in the piedmont (10-30 m relief), not the range front, so it is not confined to range fronts. Instrument S is anti-correlated with the live objective, so these numbers measure detection behaviour, not expected score.

submission.note: h66c lidar scarp diffusion inversion + Steger/Frangi lines, TIGER-road masked, 200 m catalogue-gap gate, d4 spacing

independent_reviews.note: No independent scientific-lead review was obtained in this session. The mechanical release gate therefore returns cleared_for_review = False by construction.

input_provenance.notes: Grid, CRS, shape and transform verified byte-wise against labels.tif, sample_submission.tif and training_features.tif. The raw 1 m 3DEP tiles are not reachable from this sandbox (IR-66-DATA-01), so the scarp operators run on the 2 m-computed LiDAR descriptor stack and the 100 m slope-detrended elevation. The cultural mask is the official US Census TIGER 2024 road-distance raster with a byte-level acquisition receipt.

budget.note: (1) registry calibration study, (2) corroboration + hard-negative ablation, (3) final arm selection and artifact build. No competition submission slot was spent: generating a file is not submitting one.

frozen_evidence_used.byte_verified_controlled_comparison: gemsdoe32-h33-h33-2-b2-20261004T220000Z-e5eb6e7e-zeros.tif is an exact subset of GEMSDOE30__d28-poisson300m-offcat-44090.tif: 44,090 - 37,654 = 6,436 dots removed, and every removed dot lies within 200.0 m of the public catalogue (maximum removed distance exactly 200.0 m; the minimum kept distance is 223.607 m). The owner-reported scores are 0.2600 and 0.2778. This is the only byte-level controlled comparison available in the family registry, and it is the evidence for the catalogue-gap gate.
frozen_evidence_used.gap_dose_response: Across the eight-member d2-8 lineage the owner-reported score is monotone in the fraction of dots within 200 m of the catalogue, at about -0.126 DTI per unit fraction over f200 in [0, 0.146].

limitations: No raw 1 m or 2 m DEM is reachable from this sandbox, so 'native resolution' means the 2 m-computed LiDAR descriptor stack, not a re-run of Scarplet on profiles.
The diffusion inversion constants are only defined up to the (unpinned) normalisation of the upstream LoG operator, so a_hat and kt_hat are used through rank transforms only.

The only local instrument that is positively rank-correlated with the owner-reported live scores (DTI_N, rho = +0.644) is confounded with dot count (rho = -0.844); the partial correlation is not identified from 16 rasters.
Only 60 registry rasters were scanned for uniqueness; the organiser's complete registry is not public.
No independent scientific-lead review was obtained.
